notes: Cash-basis school district (FYE 2025-08-31). Trimmed PDF has 21 pages (source_page = trimmed page: 1 Statement of Net Position, 2 Statement of Activities, 3 governmental funds balance sheet, 4 governmental funds receipts/disbursements/fund balances, 5-6 School Nutrition proprietary fund, 7-15 General Fund budget schedule with object detail, 16 Activities, 17 School Nutrition, 18 Depreciation, 19 Employee Benefit, 20 Bond, 21 Special Building). Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (2025). Total column already nets the Reclassifications column: Regular instruction 1,915,499 less 50,000 and Regular pupil transportation 447,345 less 200,000 were reclassified to transfers (to Employee Benefit and Depreciation funds); total column transfers in are 0 and transfers out 100,000 (General to School Nutrition; General to Activities 50,000 eliminated). So transfers_out 100,000 = transfer to School Nutrition (business-type transfers_net +100,000). Governmental roll: 4,496,716 + 5,573,511 - 5,472,325 - 100,000 = 4,497,902. Beginning cash is beginning fund balance (cash basis). In the General Fund detail (p9-15), the printed groups include the hidden transfers, so a contra expenditure line (negative) and an other financing line were added per group (Regular Instruction -50,000; Pupil Transportation -200,000), destinations inferred from the Depreciation and Employee Benefit transfers-in on p4; the General Fund expenditure total 4,938,852 includes transfers (150,000 printed plus 250,000 hidden net of contra). General Fund schedule p9 (summary by program) not duplicated; the object-detail pages p10-15 are recorded instead (all program groups covered: group totals agree with p9). Zero ('-') actual lines omitted (e.g. ESSERS supplies, Special Ed purchased pupil services, Bond interfund loan repayment, Special Building repairs and maintenance services). General Fund 'Other non-revenue receipt' 21,128 is printed under Other Financing Sources but is within Total Receipts 5,024,240 and the statement's receipts, so it is kept as a receipt. Business-type: School Nutrition fund (measure cash; beginning 128,441, ending 159,582). Federal and State subsidies 106,380 split into federal reimbursement 91,153 and state reimbursement 15,227 per p17. Business reported receipts total 296,460 (p17) includes the 100,000 transfer from General Fund; p6 prints separate operating 85,115 and non-operating 211,345 (sum also 296,460). Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis, 2025 Total column; no liabilities printed. Activities fund schedule has a single activity receipts/purchased services line (no per-account schedule). Read pages 1-21 of 21.
